title: Full Recovery
concept: The six-step rebuild for repeated loops or a rupture that dented trust — an explicit new agreement and a proof window, not just a better evening.
whenToUse: Repeated loops; a before/after trust dent; when Weekly Reset can't contain the topic. NOT during active conflict, NOT as a substitute for a smaller repair, NOT unless both partners have agreed to engage.
steps: Establish Warmth — atmospheric repair first. Do not skip.
Name the rupture — both perspectives, no interruption.
Explain (optional) — only if invited after impact is received.
Request + Agreement — one behaviour change; commit + by when.
Re-affirm the Alliance — “We made it through this. We're still here.”

phrases.text: I want a Full Recovery conversation — can we schedule when we're regulated?
The agreement I'm asking for is ___, visible by ___.
We made it through this. We're still here.

working: Scheduled Sunday 4pm. Warmth first. Both name the rupture. Impacts acknowledged. One Proof item for 14 days. Alliance re-affirmed. Weekly check on proof.
notWorking: Ambush Full Recovery at midnight mid-fight. Flooding + no warmth. Becomes another injury. Container matters.
activity: Schedule 60–90 regulated minutes. Bring one rupture only. Write the agreement and proof window before leaving the room.
warn: Not during active conflict. Regulated, agreed, scheduled — never an ambush.
